_comment: Hand-maintained per-table notes appended at the END of that table's section by render_schema.py. Keep them dash-free (the skill's em/en-dash check must stay 0). Add a key when a targeted amendment would otherwise be lost on the next full regeneration.
action_refunds:
Indexes: `uq_action_refunds_usage_event` (UNIQUE on `usage_event_id`, the idempotency guard),
`idx_action_refunds_agency_created`, `idx_action_refunds_tenant`.
NOTE: no FK on `usage_event_id`: `usage_events` is RANGE-partitioned and its PK is the composite
`(id, created_at)`, so a single-column reference is rejected.
backup_contact_id_as_name_20260821: _Backup table created 2026-08-21 for the contact-id-as-name cleanup. Holds the pre-cleanup `name` / `display_name` bytes so the UPDATE is reversible. Not an application table._
agency_billable_actions:
Nullability above is the COLUMN default only. The `agency_billable_actions_layer_shape`
CHECK makes the shape depend on the layer: an agency default row (`tenant_id IS NULL`)
requires `goal_name`, `label`, `price_minor`, `enabled`, `require_ai_attribution` and
`cancellation_policy` NOT NULL, while a location override (`tenant_id IS NOT NULL`)
NULL-forces all six identity fields and may carry only `price_minor` / `enabled`.
agency_whitelabel:
Resolution inputs (white-label v1, 00149): a brand resolves only when `enabled = true`, `disabled_at IS NULL`
AND the owning `tenants.membership_tier = 'elite_pro'`. `custom_css` holds the NORMALIZED sanitizer output
(raw submissions are capped at 16,384 bytes before parsing; the CHECK caps storage at 32,768). Cross-tenant
reads (child location resolving its agency brand, `/public/branding?host=`) run on the BYPASSRLS pool and
MUST carry an explicit `WHERE agency_id = $1` / `WHERE app_domain = $1`.
